# Load events

## CARD\_EXPELLED { #event-24 }

```aa2m
on CARD_EXPELLED
```

The event is fired when a character expelled from class: either killed, arrested or fired.

**Example**

```aa2m
trigger "Example" {
  on CARD_EXPELLED;
}
```

Native name: Card Expelled (Load). ID: `event-24`

## H\_END { #event-22 }

```aa2m

```

The event is fired as the H scene ends.

```aa2m
  on H_END;
}
```

Native name: H End (Load). ID: `event-22`
